messages:
Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: hey team — want to kick off a request to onboard a bilingual (EN/ES) maintenance-log summarizer model. requirement: private VPC deploy, keys via our HSM, and the model must refuse answer types that expose operator PII. pilot target: 25rps, p50 ~150ms for 128 tokens. pilot in ~5 weeks. is that doable?

Nina (CS): @Diego thanks — couple quicks: will you provide the model weights or want Redwood to host a vetted community model variant? any HIPAA/PCI? renewal cycle soon?

Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: we'll supply weights (proprietary). no HIPAA/PCI, but some logs include operator names/IDs — must be redacted or blocked. renewal is in ~2 months; success of pilot will influence renewal.

Tom (Solutions): noted. Options: Redwood Private (VPC) with HSM connector + model artifact ingestion. To hit 150ms p50 we'll likely need quantization and pinned GPUs; need to run our shortbench on their hardware profile. Also we should add a safety rule set that returns "redacted" when PII detected.

Priya (EngOps): infra notes: HSM integration requires customer test endpoint and allowlist for our connector. provisioning for VPC private deploy ~10 business days post-contract. we'll request a small perf matrix from Diego: CPU/GPU details for pilot hosts. shortbench command: `runtimes/bench --model /mnt/artifact --seq 128 --batch 1`.

Nina (CS): @Omar any legal constraints for operator IDs / PII suppression?

Omar (Legal): we'll need an NDA addendum and an MSA clause for key custody and incident response SLAs. also require a data provenance attestation from Skyline confirming dataset sources. export control low risk but we'll verify model lineage.

Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: can do NDA addendum and attestation. I've uploaded a 10k-sample to s3://skyline-pilot/samples/bilang-logs-10k.txt and a redaction map at s3://skyline-pilot/redaction/map.csv (read-only token ready).

Tom (Solutions): good. Proposed next steps:
1) CS + legal NDA addendum signed
2) infra design + HSM connector test creds
3) artifact ingestion + safety eval (PII detection + refusal tests)
4) canary deploy to Private VPC + smoke tests
Fallback: if private perf fails, fallback to a hosted variant with redaction proxy.

Priya (EngOps): for safety eval we'll run these locally once artifact and sample prompts are in place:
```
python tools/pii-detector.py --input samples/bilang-logs-10k.txt --redaction-map redaction/map.csv
run-eval --suite bilingual-robustness --model-path /mnt/artifact --max-seq 128
```
Estimate 48 hours for first-pass safety + perf.

Nina (CS): flag — Skyline's renewal in 2 months. if pilot slips >3 weeks they put renewal on hold. prioritizing kickoff helps retention.

Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: understood. what's ETA for legal and infra if we start today?

Omar (Legal): NDA addendum draft: 2-4 business days. MSA clause review: 3-7 business days.

Priya (EngOps): Infra timeline if contracts done: HSM connector test deploy: 5-8 business days; artifact ingestion + eval: 2-3 business days; canary deploy: 1-2 days. Overall optimistic ~3 weeks from signed contracts.

InfraBot: created ticket INFRA-4801: "Skyline Dynamics HSM connector & bilingual model intake" — assignee Priya. Estimated effort: 4 dev-days.

Tom (Solutions): I'll author the canary criteria doc: accuracy threshold on sample prompts, PII suppression >=99.9% on redaction checks, latency thresholds p50<=150ms. will share by EOD.

Nina (CS): scheduling kickoff: Thu 10am PT — invite sent. agenda: legal signoff, infra creds, eval criteria, retention risk. Diego confirm?

Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: confirmed Thu 10am PT. we'll DM test HSM creds and share the artifact link after NDA. thanks everyone.

Nina (CS): marking account health: at-risk if pilot delayed >3 weeks. I'll update CRM and notify AE. :rotating_light: 

Tom (Solutions): one more ask — please ensure redaction map covers operator IDs and suffix patterns, that speeds up automated checks.

Diego Alvarez - Skyline Dynamics: will extend the map and include pattern list. thanks all!"
